name: holycodex
description: Plan-aware dynamic Codex workflows with isolated orchestration, scoped rules, Git Bash on Windows, and LSP.

interface.shortDescription: Dynamic Codex workflows, isolated agents, scoped rules, Git Bash, LSP, code search, and docs lookup.
interface.longDescription: Root remains the user-facing owner of intent, architecture, integration, final judgment, and verification. For substantive work, HolyCodex lets Root author task-specific JavaScript workflows that dynamically compose isolated Codex agents through phases, branches, bounded loops, retries, fan-out, adversarial checks, and synthesis. Workflow scripts run in a capability-denied runtime and cannot directly access files, processes, environment variables, imports, credentials, or networking. Agent work continues to use Codex-native tools and inherits the active sandbox, approvals, tool restrictions, trust rules, and project boundaries. HolyCodex plans remain authoritative for permitted models, reasoning effort, low verbosity, Fast service tier, concurrency, calls, retries, depth, fan-out, projected usage, and runtime. Specialists are selectable capabilities rather than a fixed route. Normal conversation exposes concise progress and coordinated results, while explicit inspection exposes operational state without hidden reasoning, system prompts, credentials, or raw transcripts. HolyCodex installs no MCP server. Git Bash is mandatory only on native Windows; LSP and Context7 remain cross-platform.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use HolyCodex to implement and verify this task.
